name: Bistro — Restaurant
description: Restaurant for PremiumCMS (Commerce + Bookings + Restaurant plugins): a menu with modifiers and kitchen stations, delivery with postcode zones, pickup and dine-in with QR table cards, reservations, and a staff app with PIN sign-in — POS with cash/card and open tabs, cash drawer with Z reports, kitchen display per station and automatic ticket/receipt printing (browser agent or PrintNode). Seeds dishes, tables, printers, staff PINs, opening hours and delivery zones.
